sourceOfTruth: docs/phase-2f-unseen-package-validation.md §30-35, §42, §58 (original first-blind Phase 2F prose) and tests/fixtures/unseen-packages/phase-2f-freeze/phase-2f3/original-phase-2f1-rerun-package-graph.json (the exact real, byte-preserved package-graph output the classifier bug produced, hash-verified identical to the Phase 2F.1 rerun before any Phase 2F.3 code change).

issues.actualDocumentType: AMENDMENT (a Second Amendment to the Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement)
issues.actualUnderlyingInstrument: The Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated July 16, 2021 - NOT present in this package (superseded by the later Eighth A&R, Document A)
issues.expectedRelationship: AMENDS -> the Seventh A&R Credit Agreement (absent from package, so the honest expected resolution is UNRESOLVED/REVIEW_REQUIRED, never RESOLVED to Document A)
issues.phase2cRelationship: RESTATES -> null, UNRESOLVED, reason 'no explicit reference to another agreement... was found' (a second-order symptom: the reference DID exist in the source text but the old AGREEMENT_REF_RE regex could not match an ordinal-prefixed 'Amended and Restated' phrase at all)
issues.falseRelationship: Classification itself is the false claim: a Second Amendment was reported AS IF it were itself a fresh Amended and Restated base agreement.
issues.missingRelationship: The real AMENDS-shaped relationship to its true (absent) target was never even attempted with the correct relationshipType.
issues.modificationTargetImplications: Document C's own real modification candidate (amending the Consolidated Senior Secured Leverage Ratio definition) could never resolve its targetDocumentId.
issues.sourceEvidence: Document's own real text: 'SECOND AMENDMENT, dated as of August 1, 2022 (this "Amendment"), to the Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of July 16, 2021...' - evidence field on the original wrong classification literally quotes 'Amended and Restated Credit Agreement', matched from this REFERENCE clause, not from the document's own self-declared type.
issues.materiality: MATERIAL - this specific defect creates the false-ambiguity cascade in PC-04 below.
issues.downstreamImpact: Instrument grouping never linked Document C's real amendment lineage; the false AMENDED_AND_RESTATED_AGREEMENT type collided with Document A's real one.

issues.actualDocumentType: AMENDMENT (a First Omnibus Amendment, genuinely multi-target: amends BOTH the Credit Agreement and the Guarantee and Collateral Agreement)
issues.actualUnderlyingInstrument: Amends Document A's facility AND references Document B's collateral agreement - not itself a base instrument
issues.expectedRelationship: AMENDS -> Document A (Eighth A&R Credit Agreement) AND AMENDS -> Document B (Guarantee and Collateral Agreement) - a genuine multi-target amendment
issues.phase2cRelationship: SECURES -> null, UNRESOLVED, reason 'no explicit reference to another agreement... was found' (same second-order regex-narrowness symptom as PC-01: the ordinal-'Amended and Restated'-prefixed Credit Agreement reference AND the 'Guarantee and Collateral Agreement' composite-name reference could both not be matched by the original AGREEMENT_REF_RE)
issues.falseRelationship: A SECURES relationship function was implied by the (wrong) classification; the document does not itself grant or hold security - it amends the documents that do.
issues.missingRelationship: Both real AMENDS edges (to Document A and to Document B) were entirely absent.
issues.modificationTargetImplications: None detected in the original run for this document (no operative modification-statement pattern in this document's own text, distinct from PC-01's own definitional modification).
issues.sourceEvidence: Document's own real text: 'FIRST AMENDMENT AND INCREASED FACILITY ACTIVATION NOTICE, dated as of May 27, 2026 (this "Amendment"), to (a) the Eighth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of June 10, 2025... and (b) the Amended and Restated Guarantee and Collateral Agreement, dated as of the June 10, 2025...' - evidence field on the original wrong classification literally quotes 'Collateral Agreement', matched from clause (b)'s reference, not from the document's own self-declared type.
issues.materiality: MATERIAL - this document's real function (amending BOTH the facility and its collateral package) was entirely invisible.
issues.downstreamImpact: The real multi-target amendment relationship was completely absent from the package graph; instrument grouping could not place this document anywhere.

issues.actualDocumentType: A composite Guarantee AND Collateral/Security Agreement - both a guaranty of the Credit Agreement obligations AND a grant of a security interest in collateral
issues.actualUnderlyingInstrument: Cross-cutting document associated with Document A's facility (not itself a base instrument)
issues.phase2cInstrumentGrouping: Excluded from instrument grouping (correct exclusion behavior, but under an incomplete type)
issues.expectedRelationship: GUARANTEES -> Document A AND SECURES -> Document A (both real functions of this one real document)
issues.phase2cRelationship: SECURES -> null, UNRESOLVED, reason 'no explicit reference to another agreement... was found' (same regex-narrowness symptom, plus the classification itself only ever implied the SECURES function, never GUARANTEES, since the old single-value RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_BY_SOURCE_CLASSIFICATION map could not represent a document with two real functions)
issues.falseRelationship: None outright false, but incomplete - the classification (and consequently the relationship function) silently dropped this document's real guaranty function.
issues.missingRelationship: The real GUARANTEES -> Document A edge was structurally impossible to produce under the old architecture (SECURITY_AGREEMENT could only ever map to SECURES).
issues.sourceEvidence: Document's own real title: 'AMENDED AND RESTATED GUARANTEE AND COLLATERAL AGREEMENT' - the original Phase 2F report itself called this 'a plausible partial match for a combined guarantee-and-security document', explicitly flagging the incompleteness rather than a hard misclassification.
issues.materiality: MATERIAL for completeness of the package's own relationship model, though not itself a false-certainty defect.
issues.downstreamImpact: No GUARANTEES-typed edge existed anywhere in the package for this real, guarantee-bearing document.

issues.sourceDocument: conmed-doc-a-eighth-ar-credit-agreement (target side); every document with a bare named-agreement mention (source side, 84 leads)
issues.actualDocumentType: N/A - a cross-document-reference-lead resolution defect, not a document-classification defect
issues.expectedRelationship: A bare 'the Credit Agreement' mention, with only ONE real Credit-Agreement-type document in the package (Document A), should resolve by unique type match (REVIEW_REQUIRED, per the existing architecture's own honest confidence tier for a date-less bare mention).
issues.phase2cRelationship: 67 of 84 cross-document reference leads report UNRESOLVED, reason '2 candidate documents of type CREDIT_AGREEMENT/AMENDED_AND_RESTATED_AGREEMENT exist - never resolved from a bare named mention alone' - a FALSE ambiguity, since there is only ONE real Credit Agreement in this package (Document A); the second 'candidate' is Document C, false-classified as AMENDED_AND_RESTATED_AGREEMENT per PC-01.
issues.falseRelationship: None (correctly stayed unresolved, per the governing invariant) - but for the WRONG reason (a fabricated ambiguity, not real ambiguity).
issues.missingRelationship: 67 real, cleanly-resolvable cross-document reference leads were denied resolution by a false ambiguity entirely caused by PC-01.
issues.sourceEvidence: docs/phase-2f-unseen-package-validation.md §33: 'This is the direct, traced consequence of the §30 misclassification: Document C's false typing as a second AMENDED_AND_RESTATED_AGREEMENT creates a false ambiguity between it and the real Document A.'
issues.materiality: MATERIAL - the single largest-volume defect in the original package-graph run (67 of 84 leads affected).
issues.downstreamImpact: Every downstream consumer of cross-document reference leads (amendment-lead recall, per §42 of the original report, cited 0% recall) inherited this false ambiguity.
